data.name: Connectors
data.comment: Page title, heading, breadcrumb and PageInfo title: the plural name of the list page.

data.name: Connector
data.comment: Singular name: grid noun and PageInfo title on the detail page.

data.name: ListPageInfo
data.value: JIM uses Connectors to connect to external systems and import or export data. A number are pre-supplied as built-in Connectors for common system types, but you can also install third-party Connectors. From here you can see which are installed and if any have updates that can be applied.
data.comment: PageInfo popover on the list page.

data.name: SiblingPagesAriaLabel
data.comment: Accessible name of the toggle between the two sibling pages.

data.name: ColumnDescription
data.comment: Table column heading and field label.

data.name: ColumnBuiltIn
data.comment: Table column heading and field label: whether the Connector ships with JIM.

data.name: ColumnInUse
data.comment: Table column heading: whether any Connected System uses the Connector.

data.name: ColumnVersion
data.comment: Table column heading.

data.name: Yes
data.comment: Boolean cell value.

data.name: No
data.comment: Boolean cell value.

data.name: NoConnectorsMatch

data.name: NoConnectorsInstalled
data.comment: Empty state of the list when there are none.

data.name: NoConnectorsInstalledHint
data.value: Built-in Connectors appear here once JIM has initialised.
data.comment: Hint under the empty state.

data.name: DetailHeading

data.name: DetailPageTitle
data.comment: Browser tab title. {0} is the Connector's name.

data.name: DetailPageInfo
data.value: A Connector is how JIM talks to one kind of system, such as a directory or a database. This page shows what it is and what it can do.
data.comment: PageInfo popover on the detail page.
